_doc: Props made by text-to-image-to-3D (MOSS-Image-SFT -> Hunyuan3D-2mini -> Hi3D 1.0 -> Hunyuan3D-Paint), then cleaned to kit conventions by tools/text_to_3d/finish_props.py. size: the real dimension in metres the finished prop is scaled to ('h' height, 'l' longest horizontal side). budget: triangle target. res: Hi3D refinement grid. front: the side the image shows becomes the prop's +Y. rejected: reviewed and judged not good enough (docs/qa/asset_audit.md); the kit ignores its file and always draws the fallback. fallback: the code prop the kit draws while this one is not finished (none: nothing is drawn); library key genprop.<id>. Everything is fictional: no real players, managers, clubs, trophies or lettering.

style.suffix: , the entire object fully visible and centred in frame, eye-level front view, isolated on a plain pure white seamless background, soft even diffuse studio lighting, photorealistic product photograph, sharp focus, true-to-life materials
style.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, writing, logo, brand name, watermark, signature stamp, person, people, hands, multiple separate objects, cropped, cut off, out of frame, floor, ground plane, cast shadow, scenery, background objects, blurry, cartoon, illustration, 3d render look, toy, miniature

props.prompt: a bronze statue of a fictional 1960s footballer in mid celebration, one arm raised with clenched fist, mouth open in a shout, short-sleeved collared football shirt, shorts, long socks and laced boots, generic anonymous face, mounted on a tall square plinth of dark charcoal-grey polished granite, dark brown bronze patina with green verdigris streaks and polished highlights on the knees and boots

a bronze statue of a fictional middle-aged football manager standing upright with his arms folded across his chest, knee-length overcoat over a suit and tie, determined expression, generic anonymous face, on a tall square plinth of dark red-brown polished granite with a moulded cap, dark brown bronze patina with subtle green verdigris

a bronze head-and-shoulders portrait bust of a fictional elderly club chairman with neat swept-back hair, jacket and tie, generic anonymous face, on a tall polished speckled grey granite pedestal with a stepped base, warm brown bronze patina

a heroic bronze statue of a male lion standing proudly with one front paw resting on a round soccer ball, full flowing mane, on a rectangular rough-hewn grey granite plinth, dark bronze patina with green verdigris in the crevices and polished paw

a tall abstract public sculpture shaped like a fictional football club shield crest with a stylised star, made of interlocking brushed and weathered corten steel plates with visible bolts and welded seams, rusty orange-brown patina, standing on a low square concrete base

an upright rough-cut slab of very dark blue-grey slate memorial stone, much larger than its plaque, with a rectangular bronze plaque fixed to its face, the plaque blank with only a raised border, set on a small flagstone base, weathered with lichen spots

a short square oak timber memorial post with a small blank brass plaque on the front, a bouquet of wrapped flowers in cellophane and a folded red and white scarf leaning against its base, weathered silver-grey wood grain

an oversized perfectly round bronze soccer ball with clearly defined hexagon and pentagon panels and stitched seams, resting on a round tapered plinth of dark grey polished granite with a moulded top edge, polished bronze highlights on top with darker patina below

an ornamental Victorian stone fountain with a wide round carved basin on a fluted pedestal and a smaller upper bowl with a pineapple finial, weathered mid-grey granite with darker water stains and green moss in the carvings, no water

a Victorian-style cast iron street clock on a tall fluted pillar with an ornate base, a round clock head with two white dials with black roman numerals and black hands and a small decorative crown finial, painted gloss dark green with gold trim, slightly chipped paint

an ornate fictional league championship trophy in polished sterling silver, a tall urn-shaped cup with two slender scroll handles on a round stepped foot, topped by a lid shaped like a small royal crown, on a black turned wooden base with a silver band, mirror-like reflections

a large fictional silver cup trophy with two very big looping ear-shaped handles, wide bowl on a slim stem and round foot, red and white satin ribbons tied to both handles hanging down, polished silver with soft reflections
a fictional football shield trophy, a round embossed silver plate with an ornate border mounted upright on a stepped dark mahogany wooden base with small blank silver name plates around it

a group of five small youth football trophies standing together, gold-coloured plastic footballer figurines and small cups on stacked white marble-effect bases of different heights, close together as one cluster
three football medals, gold, silver and bronze, hanging on thick red and white striped ribbons from a small dark walnut wooden display stand, the medal faces embossed with a football
a signed white match football with thin blue and red panel graphics resting on a small square black lacquered display plinth with a ball cup, scribbled marker signatures on the ball

a deep black wooden box frame hanging upright containing a red football shirt with white collar and cuffs pinned flat inside behind glass, black marker signatures scribbled across the chest, no numbers or lettering, cream mount board

a tall solid oak trophy display cabinet with open fronted shelves and no doors, four shelves crowded with assorted silver cups, gold trophies, shields and framed photographs, warm honey oak with brass trim
a worn white and black match football heavily caked with wet brown mud and grass stains, scuffed panels with peeling edges

a perfectly spherical vintage 1950s brown leather soccer ball made of eighteen stitched rectangular leather panels in a woven pattern, round like a modern football, cracked, scuffed and darkened old leather
a black mesh drawstring sack stuffed full with about ten white and yellow training footballs, standing upright on its own, balls bulging through the netting, drawstring cord at the top
a pair of black leather football boots with white trim and studs side by side, laces loose, caked in drying brown mud and grass clippings on the soles and toes
a pair of goalkeeper gloves lying palm up next to each other, thick grey latex palms worn and dirty, bright green and black backs with velcro wrist straps
a large wicker laundry hamper basket on castors overflowing with crumpled red and white football shirts, shorts and socks spilling over the rim, one shirt hanging down the side
a neat stack of folded mesh training bibs in mixed colours, fluorescent yellow, orange, blue and green layers, slightly untidy edges
a large black and red sports holdall kit bag with a separate zipped boot compartment at one end, padded shoulder strap, carry handles, full and slightly bulging, standing on the ground
a black plastic six-bottle water carrier crate with a tall centre carry handle holding six squeezy sports water bottles with red caps
a whiteboard tactics board on a three-legged aluminium easel stand, the board printed with green football pitch markings and scattered red and blue round magnetic player counters
a large blue inflatable gym swiss ball with subtle seam lines and a small valve, slightly scuffed matte rubber
a set of four black rubber medicine balls with coloured grip bands, red, yellow, green and blue, resting on a low two-tier black steel storage rack
a row of five cast iron kettlebells of increasing size lined up on the floor, matte black powder coat with coloured handle bands, scuffed edges
a stack of six foam rollers lying horizontally in a pyramid, mixed black, blue and orange, some with textured grid surfaces
a black steel wall-mounted hook rail with colourful looped rubber resistance bands hanging down in red, yellow, green, blue and black
three nested plyometric jump boxes in graduating heights stacked together, dense grey foam covered in black vinyl with grippy tops and worn edges

a wheeled pitch line marking machine for painting white lines on grass, a red painted steel frame with a white paint tank, two rubber wheels, a marking wheel at the front and a long push handle, paint splashes
a green steel wheelbarrow with a pneumatic tyre half full of soil, a garden fork and a leaf rake leaning against it with their wooden handles upright
a heavy duty red steel wheeled hose reel cart with a long green garden hose neatly coiled around the drum and a spray nozzle on the end
a travelling lawn sprinkler for sports pitches, a yellow cast metal body on three steel wheels with twin rotating spray arms on top, a hose connector at the back
a pedestrian cylinder lawn mower for fine turf, green engine cowling, a front grass collection box, heavy rear roller and a bent steel handlebar, used and grass stained
a black rubber bucket full of sand and seed mix with a hand fork, a trowel and a small divot repair tool leaning out of it, a pair of worn work gloves draped on the rim

a traditional British cylindrical cast iron pillar post box painted gloss red with a black base, a domed cap, a horizontal posting slot and a small blank collection plate, the cypher and all lettering omitted, slightly chipped paint

a white vintage-style catering food van seen from the side with its large serving hatch propped open and an awning, a stainless steel counter inside the hatch, round headlights, chrome trim and black tyres, no signage
a small mobile coffee cart on two wheels with a dark green painted wooden body, a striped cream and green canopy on poles, an espresso machine and stacked paper cups on the counter, no signage

a market stall gazebo with a red and white striped canopy and a trestle table, rows of red and white striped knitted football scarves hanging from the front rail and folded scarves and bobble hats on the table, no lettering
a pile of folded red and white fabric football flags on the ground beside a long rolled-up fabric banner tied with rope, plain coloured fabric with no lettering
a parked black city bicycle on its kickstand seen from the side, upright handlebars, brown leather saddle, mudguards, a wicker basket on the front, thick tyres and spoked wheels
a feral city pigeon standing alert, blue-grey feathers with iridescent green and purple neck, two dark wing bars, pink feet, seen from the side
a feral city pigeon bent forward pecking at the ground, blue-grey feathers with iridescent green neck and dark wing bars, pink feet, seen from the side
a herring gull standing upright, white head and body, pale grey wings with black wingtips and white spots, yellow hooked beak with a red spot, pink legs, seen from the side
a herring gull standing with both wings raised and half spread about to take off, white body, pale grey wings with black tips, yellow beak, pink legs
an urban red fox standing on all four legs looking alert, slightly scruffy orange-red coat, white chest and muzzle, black legs and ear backs, bushy tail with a white tip, seen from the side
a small low pile of fallen autumn leaves in brown, orange and yellow mixed with a few dry twigs and sycamore seeds, viewed from slightly above
a small cluster of matchday litter, two crushed clear plastic pint cups, a crumpled paper food tray and a dropped folded glossy match programme with a plain red cover, viewed from slightly above
